Contract: OCI image contract: HomeHub supplies the JSON config plus read-only source/config and writable source-state/backup/change/log bind mounts; SourceStatePath stores the source hash-cache MANIFEST.csv outside the read-only source. The one-shot container returns 0 only for a complete run and deposits Windows/POSIX recovery entry points. One BackupSet per container invocation — HomeHub runs one service/invocation per directory (ruled 2026-08-21); multi-set configs are a native-Windows convenience. HomeHub owns mount-identity preflight, scheduling, retention POLICY, and NagLight translation around that exit status; HomeHub must never delete Snapshot_* folders directly — snapshot pruning is FileBackup's mechanism (planned Prune-Snapshot verb; dedup means one snapshot's bytes may be the only physical copy other snapshots recover by hash). See README 'Run as a Linux container'.
